{"reason":"Broaden the demand-forecast condition to include market-signal mismatches and lower the bias cutoff from 0.1 to 0.05. This corrects the cited unknown rows with biases 0.065–0.081 or market-mismatch=#t, improving accuracy above 0.708 while increasing recovery beyond 3,161,000.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
